findings.finding: A $15M firm-commitment offering via Univest, filed as a preliminary F-1 on 2026-10-01, is about ten times the ~$1.5M market cap and can price at a discount overnight once the SEC declares it effective, which could happen inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A firm-commitment F-1 with Univest prices and is announced the night it goes effective (this issuer's Oct-2024 Univest deal priced on 2024-10-02 and closed about a day later). The registration was filed 2026-10-01 and the closing date is left blank, so pricing by the 2026-10-05 close is possible but not likely. A fresh F-1 normally needs SEC review or a no-review notice; this issuer's January 2026 F-1 took three amendments to 2026-03-20. That probability is what keeps the size small.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-10-05 if declared effective and priced; otherwise later and outside the window
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline own falls: 2026-08-17 to 08-19 was a three-day cluster (-16%, -10%, -16%) with next closes of -10.2%, -16.5% and -3.9%. 2026-10-01's -14% was followed by today's -11.8%. Clustered supply has repeatedly carried this name lower for several sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: The two-day fall prices the filing as an overhang, but not the deal terms. At $1.95 a $15M raise needs about 7.7M shares, roughly ten times the shares outstanding, so a priced deal would come at a deep discount to the close plus pre-funded warrants. If the price held that, it would already trade near a discounted offer level and not at a price set by a $0.33M-turnover tape on 0.66x volume.
findings.independence: The issuer's own 6-K of 2026-09-30 (cash $755k, going-concern doubt, ~5 months of runway) shows the money is needed now, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888014/000121390026105355/ea0306489-6k_akanda.htm; the Univest precedent of 2024-10-02, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888014/000121390024084330/ea021643601ex99-1_akanda.htm

findings.finding: The January 2026 convertible notes (resale of up to 3,752,212 shares registered on a 424B3 of 2026-01-21) convert at the lower of a fixed price, 85% of 5-day VWAP or 85% of the prior close. The floor of $0.254 pre-split is about $1.14 after the April 4.5-for-1 reverse split, still below spot, so note holders can convert and sell into every session of the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Conversion is daily and at the holder's option, at 85% of the prior close, so it supplies stock on 2026-10-05 as on any session. The resale is already registered (424B3, 2026-01-21), so nothing has to be filed first.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 60-day run-up is -78.2% and the 20-day is -40.9%, with 12 falls of 8% or more since 2026-07-21 and a median next close of -0.81% (up rate 42.2%) over 90 comparable falls, which is consistent with continuous conversion selling. No filing gives the remaining note balance, so this is inference from the terms and the tape.
findings.why_not_priced: A discount-to-VWAP convertible resets lower with every close, so each session's fall widens the share count the next conversion delivers. The price takes in yesterday's supply, not tomorrow's. If the seller were finished, a disclosed full conversion or repayment would exist, and none is filed.
findings.independence: The 6-K of 2026-01-20 gives the same conversion terms and Univest as placement agent: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888014/000121390026005399/ea0273313-6k_akanda.htm. The 6-K of 2026-09-30 lists finance expense up to $820k in H1 2026, consistent with notes still outstanding.

outside_window.finding: Going-concern doubt with about five months of runway from 2026-06-30 cash of $755k means more financing after this offering, likely before year end.
Convertible notes issued 2026-01-21 mature 12 months later (10% interest, 18% default rate), a repayment or default point.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with this name's own history (42% up rate, clustered multi-day falls) and with the deep 60-day drawdown and high ATR, but cut against the low volume (0.66x, where the cross-section base rate is positive) and the cross-section prior of +0.4. That tension is why p_up is 42 and not lower, and why the scaled number (-1.28) is well under the findings sum (-3.5).
